variants.headline: {{city}}, capital of {{loser}}, falls to {{winner}}
body: Forces of {{winner}} seized {{city}}, bringing a capital close to our own cities under new rule.

variants.headline: {{city}} falls to {{winner}}
body: The capture of {{city}} gives {{winner}} a foothold close to our own cities.

variants.headline: Capital of {{loser}} falls to {{winner}}
body: Forces of {{winner}} seized the capital of {{loser}}, bringing a city close to our own under new rule.

variants.headline: A new landmark in {{city}}: {{wonder}}
body: We are at war with {{owner}}, but the news from nearby {{city}} concerns its builders. Work on the wonder is complete.

variants.headline: {{cityState}} leaves our alliance for {{rival}}
body: Our alliance with {{cityState}} ended when the city-state made common cause with {{rival}}. The change gives our rival an ally close to our own cities.

variants.headline: War between {{initiator}} and {{target}} draws in {{vassals}}
body: The declaration of war came from {{initiator}} and was aimed at {{target}}. Bound by obligations to their masters, {{vassals}} went to war as well.

variants.headline: Our momentum ebbs in the war with {{opponent}}
body: We held a clear advantage earlier in the war against {{opponent}}. Lately the balance has hardly shifted. What once looked like momentum now looks like a long war.
